parties: Johnson Controls-Hitachi Air Conditioning Holding (UK) Ltd (acquirer) / Bosch Home Comfort India Limited (HCIL) (target)
headline: Johnson Controls-Hitachi Air Conditioning files SEBI takeover disclosure for Bosch Home Comfort India
sum: Johnson Controls-Hitachi Air Conditioning Holding (UK) Ltd filed a Regulation 31(4) disclosure under the SEBI Takeover Code on 23 June 2026, signalling a substantial acquisition in Bosch Home Comfort India Limited (HCIL), a listed air conditioning manufacturer. The filing confirms intent to acquire a material stake, triggering mandatory takeover requirements.
detail: Johnson Controls-Hitachi Air Conditioning Holding (UK) Ltd, the UK-based joint venture entity, submitted the mandatory disclosure to NSE under SEBI's Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers Regulations, 2011, Regulation 31(4). This disclosure is triggered when an acquirer acquires shares such that it crosses 25% of voting capital or commits to a full or partial open offer. Bosch Home Comfort India Limited is a listed air conditioning company trading on NSE. The disclosure obligates the acquirer to file detailed information regarding the acquisition, shareholding pattern, funding source, and offer strategy within statutory timelines.
